scenes.title: Stipendium Hungaricum has two selection points.
scenes.sub: Many applicants prepare for only one.
scenes.say: Stipendium Hungaricum has two selection points, and many applicants only prepare for one.

scenes.title: Your Sending Partner nominates you
scenes.say: First, your country's Sending Partner must nominate you. Without that nomination, your application isn't considered.

scenes.title: The university admits you
scenes.body: Often an entrance exam or an interview.
scenes.say: Second, the Hungarian university runs its own admission, often with an entrance exam or an interview.

scenes.title: In the 2026/27 call
scenes.say: In the twenty twenty-six to twenty-seven call, you could apply for up to two programmes, and it covered tuition, a monthly stipend, housing support and medical insurance.
